title: Why Malenia was born rotting in Elden Ring
subject: malenia
description:
Would you have kept fighting with Malenia's curse? 👇

How the Blade of Miquella was born carrying the Scarlet Rot, and how she still became the warrior who never lost. Spoilers for Elden Ring.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FromSoftware or Bandai Namco Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Malenia was born with a god of rot living inside her.
She and her twin Miquella were children of Queen Marika and Radagon, two Empyreans who might one day rule.
Both twins were cursed. Miquella would never grow up, and Malenia's body slowly decayed from the Scarlet Rot.
Miquella searched for years for a cure, and forged a needle of unalloyed gold to hold the rot back.
She fought with a prosthetic arm and one katana, and every wound she dealt healed her own.
That's how a dying girl became the Blade of Miquella, and never lost a fight.
